Maddie's Fund Education is a program of Maddie's Fund, the nation's leading funder of shelter medicine education.  Visit university.maddiesfund.org for free courses and a chance to earn certificates! 

If your pet is experiencing medical issues, please contact your veterinarian. Maddie's Fund welcomes your comments, but we cannot endorse or recommend medical advice posted by third parties in the comments section.
